name: write
description:
Write the current table to OUT: the last step of a pipeline.

The file is written whole or not at all: a failed step or write leaves it as it was. With --dry-run nothing is written. A closed output (`| head`) ends the pipeline quietly.

--columns and --rename choose, order and name the output columns; a name the table lacks, or two columns with one name, is refused (exit 2) with the columns there are.

Example: semkit read core.csv dupes --kind exact --action drop write out.csv --overwrite

Chosen columns, renamed: semkit read phrases.csv nearest --to Q write - --columns phrase,similarity --rename similarity=сходство

options.name: --columns
options.description: The columns to write, in this order: a comma list, repeatable. By default all, as the steps made them.

options.name: --rename
options.description: Write the column OLD under the name NEW, repeatable; applied after --columns, so OLD is a name the selection keeps. A swap a=b, b=a is allowed.

arguments.name: OUT
arguments.description: The file to write, its format by its extension; '-' for JSONL on stdout.
